text:
maya: Quick sync — thinking about adding a "preview + quarantine" flow to the console for automatic fallback policies. want to capture audit + operator override before a policy goes live.
vikram: sounds useful. what do you mean by quarantine?
maya: quarantine = route affected traffic to a degraded model variant but keep full logs and a separate billing bucket so product teams can inspect before full rollback.
samir: does quarantine imply separate quotas? curious about billing blowups.
maya: yes separate quota bucket (metered) + optional soft-throttle. the idea: you can see impact without touching main traffic.
jess: will this add more oscillation risk? if policy flips between normal/quarantine a lot we could hurt user latency.
lin: we should add hysteresis and cooldown. e.g. require 2 consecutive windows before switching and 10m cooldown.
maya: agreed. also want a preview diff UI that shows what changes will occur, including sample telemetry and estimated token delta.
vikram: for audit, can we sample 100% for first 24h then downsample? retention should be configurable per org.
samir: +1. suggest audit metadata include operator id, policy diff, deploy id, and a hash for reproducibility.
maya: rough policy snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "policy": "auto-fallback",
  "trigger": {"error_rate": ">=3%", "window": "5m"},
  "modes": ["soft-degrade", "quarantine"],
  "quarantine": {"quota_bucket": "quarantine-usage", "billing_meta": "isolation", "retain_days": 90},
  "hysteresis": {"required_windows": 2, "cooldown": "10m"},
  "audit": {"sample": "100%:24h->10%", "log_fields": ["operator","deploy_id","policy_hash"]}
}
```
jess: UI question — how do we surface the expected latency/cost tradeoff? teams need to know expected token and latency delta before enabling.
lin: compute a delta simulation using recent traffic window. show a confidence interval and worst-case estimate.
maya: also add an escape-hatch button in the top-right of the policy panel: "force-exit quarantine" with confirmation and automatic incident ticket creation via ci-bot.
ci-bot: Incident created #AUTO-QUARANTINE-4412345678 when force-exit used. Please include postmortem tag.
vikram: integration note: console should emit a policy-change event to telemetry pipeline with versioned schema so we can replay in the sim infra.
samir: on retention, security will want admin override for retain_days > org max. document that in policy editor.
jess: UX: preview diff should highlight the affected routes, percentage of traffic, and expected rollout duration. small mock: [screenshot placeholder]
maya: OK next steps: design mockups + telemetry schema, implement editor preview diff + cooldown enforcement in runtime, and a small pilot with two internal teams.
lin: I'll draft the telemetry schema and cooldown enforcement PR.
vikram: I'll add the quota-bucket plumbing and billing tags.
samir: I'll write the audit-log spec and policy hash algorithm.
maya: sweet. Ping me when you have PRs, will coordinate pilot and notify support teams. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Deploybot: policy-preview service deployed to staging at 4412345740.
